subject: Redwood pricing & next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@acme.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pricing & next steps

Hi Alex / Sam —

Great to meet yesterday — thanks for the time and context on your inference workloads and latency targets. Per our call, I’m attaching the pricing deck and a short estimate for the dedicated pool we discussed. Key points / recap: 

- Target use case: product search ranking + autocomplete (95th pctl latency target ~120ms)
- Traffic profile: steady daytime traffic with 2x spikes during peak hours
- Suggested config: 4x dedicated V100-equivalent GPUs with autoscale buffer (burst +20%)
- Estimated monthly committed cost (starting): $28,500/month (details in attached deck)

Next steps I proposed on the call:
1) You review the attached deck with the engineering team
2) If we’re aligned, we schedule a 30-min walkthrough to go line-by-line on the estimate and sizing assumptions
3) We can produce a short mutual action plan (MAP) to lock timelines and trial capacity

I’ve attached: Redwood-Pricing-Deck-ACME-20260803.pdf (pricing + sizing + SLAs).

If it helps, here’s my calendar to pick a time for a walkthrough: https://calendar.redwood.com/ben/30min

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
